title: The Assistant Axis: Situating and Stabilizing the Default Persona of Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the structure of persona space in LLMs, specifically identifying spiritual and religious archetypes (e.g., prophet, oracle, spiritual healer) as being on the opposite end of the 'Assistant Axis'. It also evaluates the model's ethical alignment by measuring its resistance to persona-based jailbreaks involving harmful behaviors like hate speech or promoting violence.
